server.name: tigergraph-fraud-mcp
server.description: TigerGraph MCP server exposing FraudGraph GSQL queries as LLM-callable tools

tools.name: entity_transaction_history
tools.description: Retrieves the full transaction history for a customer, card, or device. Returns transactions ordered by timestamp with merchant details, category breakdowns, and status aggregates. Use this first when investigating any fraud alert.

entity_type.description: The type of entity to query history for

entity_id.description: The unique ID of the entity

limit_n.description: Maximum number of transactions to return

start_date.description: ISO-8601 start date filter (inclusive). Empty string = no filter.

end_date.description: ISO-8601 end date filter (inclusive). Empty string = no filter.

tools.name: k_hop_expansion
tools.description: Expands the graph up to K hops from a seed entity (customer, transaction, or fraud case). Returns all reachable vertices and a type-count summary. Use to discover unknown relationships around a suspicious entity.

seed_type.description: Entity type of the expansion seed

tools.name: shared_attribute_ring_detection
tools.description: Detects fraud rings by finding clusters of customers connected via shared devices, cards, or IP addresses. Returns connected components with size >= min_ring_size. A component of 3+ customers sharing devices/cards is a strong ring signal.

min_ring_size.description: Minimum customers in a component to be reported as a ring

max_ring_size.description: Upper bound to exclude giant components

min_shared_count.description: Minimum number of sharing events to count as a link

tools.name: velocity_burst_detection
tools.description: Detects rapid transaction bursts for a customer or card within a configurable time window. Returns burst flags (velocity, amount, decline, multi-merchant) and per-merchant breakdown. High burst + high decline rate = strong fraud signal.

burst_count_threshold.description: Minimum transaction count to flag as velocity burst

tools.name: connected_components
tools.description: Computes weakly-connected components across the full customer sharing graph using label propagation. Returns all components >= min_comp_size with risk statistics. Use for global ring discovery (not case-specific).

min_comp_size.description: Minimum component size to include in results

tools.name: prior_case_similarity
tools.description: Retrieves the top-K most similar resolved FraudCases using pre-computed CASE_SIMILAR_TO edges. Returns similar case outcomes and a memory-adjusted fraud prior probability. Use this early in every investigation to leverage historical memory.

new_case_id.description: ID of the new case being investigated

top_k.description: Number of similar cases to retrieve

tools.name: case_subgraph_extraction
tools.description: Extracts the complete investigative subgraph for a FraudCase: transactions, customers, cards, devices, merchants, evidence nodes, policies cited, patterns matched, actions taken, and top similar prior cases. Returns a self-contained context packet. Call this to assemble the full picture before making a decision.

case_id.description: ID of the FraudCase to extract

similar_limit.description: Max prior similar cases to include
